launched: 2025 (revealed March 2025; ADAC DE catalogue lists variants from 12/2025)
rationale: Volvo's only saloon in Europe and a 5.0 m E-segment BEV aimed squarely at the i5: Auto Express (Apr 2026) names the BMW i5 and Audi A6 e-tron as the obvious alternatives and benchmarks its dimensions against the i5; Move Electric compares it directly with the i5 on interior, ride and boot; ADAC lists the i5 as a segment competitor. Chosen as the Volvo/Polestar representative (Polestar 5 too new, Polestar 4 is an SUV-coupe).

rationale: 5.1 m Chinese premium BEV saloon sold in Germany, the Netherlands and the Nordics, with battery swap and battery-rental pricing. Auto Swiat (Mar 2024, with Auto Bild photos) ran it head to head against the BMW i5 M60 and Mercedes-AMG EQE 53 (i5 won 621 points; ET7 tied second on 572). Chosen as the Chinese-brand challenger that is closest in size and price to the 5 Series in Europe; BYD Seal/NIO ET5 are D-segment, BYD Han is barely sold in the EU.

launched: 2021 (refresh); UK return in 2023 as left-hand drive only (Auto Express); DE variants through 04/2026
rationale: Tesla's E-segment saloon (5.02 m, about the length of a 5 Series per Auto Express). UK press group-tests it against the i5: Autocar ran Model S Plaid vs BMW i5 M60 vs Mercedes-AMG EQE 53 (Autocar itself returned 402; verdict taken from the BMWBlog summary, Jan 2024: EQE 53 first, Model S Plaid second, i5 M60 third). Kept as the segment-correct Tesla even though it is being discontinued and has almost no current-generation European owner voice.
next_generation: Discontinued, no successor named: ADAC catalogue shows Model S Plaid 10/25-04/26 (Modellende 04/26); AutoScout24 (Jan 2026) says production ends in late 2026 and Fremont lines are converted to Optimus robots.
